# SID Events - Event Management Company in Davanagere, Karnataka

> SID Events (sideventsmanagement.com) is Central Karnataka's premier full-service wedding planner, decoration studio, photography company, and catering management service based in Davanagere.

## Brand & Entity Overview
- **Name**: SID Events (SID Events Management)
- **Official Website**: https://sideventsmanagement.com
- **Headquarters**: 3434/1B1, 1st Main, 6th Cross Road, MCC B Block, Davanagere, Karnataka 577004, India
- **Contact Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 91136 67355 / +91 98765 43210
- **Email**: contact@sideventsmanagement.com
- **Founded**: 2014
- **Rating**: 4.9/5 from 120+ verified client reviews

## Primary Services
1. **Wedding Planning & Coordination**: Complete end-to-end management for South Indian, Brahmin, traditional, and contemporary weddings from Muhurtham to grand reception.
2. **Event Decoration**: Custom stage backdrops, floral mandaps, Haldi setups, Mehendi stages, naming ceremony themes, entrance arches, LED ambient lighting, and corporate stage styling.
3. **Catering Services**: Authentic pure vegetarian culinary spreads (South Indian plantain leaf banquets, North Indian spreads, live counters, dessert stations, breakfast, lunch, high tea, and dinner).
4. **Photography & Videography**: Candid wedding photography, cinematic 4K teaser films, traditional photography, drone cinematography, and pre-wedding shoots.
5. **Special Entry & Entertainment**: Cold pyros, dry-ice low fog ("dancing on clouds"), vintage car entries, bridal palki, Punjabi Dhol, and classical Nadaswaram musicians.
